interpretation: P0 names enforcement and test seams; it does not claim failed gates are repaired.

gates.name: benchmark_blindness
gates.enforcement_seam: P1 hook quarantine plus production-path reachability scanner

gates.name: identity_authority
gates.current_owner: entity alias/canonical referent repositories plus maintenance writers
gates.enforcement_seam: P2 registered writer authority and P3 governed identity applier
gates.test_seam: P0 writer census followed by P2/P3 raw-SQL bypass and correction tests

gates.name: total_evidence_fate
gates.test_seam: P3 sealed mixed-source mention population with one fate per opportunity

gates.name: admission_isolation
gates.current_owner: Model/relation formation, repositories, and default readers

gates.test_seam: P0 illegal-state fixtures followed by P2 reader/endpoint leakage tests

gates.name: evidence_lineage

gates.test_seam: P2 missing, cross-tenant, future, whole-batch, and transitive evidence cases

gates.name: claim_local_scope

gates.test_seam: P2 interleaved-story scope oracle and P6 mixed-stream score

gates.name: representation_coherence
gates.enforcement_seam: P2 immutable semantic version with proposition and renderer digests
gates.test_seam: P2 natural-only/proposition-only mutation and rebuild-parity tests

gates.name: lifecycle_closure
gates.current_owner: Model events, falsifier, applier, maintenance, and dependent repair

gates.test_seam: P2 fault injection, concurrent confirm/falsify, and stale-read tests

gates.name: relation_validity

gates.name: plane_isolation

gates.name: online_causal_availability
gates.current_owner: Think worker, post-commit queues, retrieval indexes, and lifecycle repair

gates.name: feedback_attribution

gates.test_seam: P0 receipt round-trip/tamper tests and phase-specific member-level evaluator tests
